description: This file defines a Python class 'ResNet50Pretrained' for image classification using a ResNet50 model. It includes methods for loading classes, loading images, setting model weights, loading the model, and classifying images, with support for both single images and directories.

classes.name: ResNet50Pretrained
classes.description: A class for loading a ResNet50 model, loading class labels, and classifying images with support for model weight management.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the ResNet50Pretrained object, sets up the model, loads class labels, and determines device.

methods.name: __load_classes
methods.description: Loads class labels from a specified file.

methods.name: __load_image
methods.description: Loads images from a file or directory, preprocesses them for model input.

methods.name: model_path
methods.description: Property to get or set the model weight file path.

methods.name: set_model_path
methods.description: Sets the path to the pretrained model weights.

methods.name: load_model
methods.description: Loads the model weights into the ResNet50 model.

methods.name: classify
methods.description: Classifies images from a file or directory, returning top predictions.
